281353829.description: This is a fossilized leaf specimen preserved in a slab of sedimentary rock. The fossil displays a well-defined leaf form with prominent veins, characteristic of a deciduous tree species. The leaf fossil is brown in color and contrasts against the light gray-beige stone matrix. The irregular slab measures approximately 27 cm by 23 cm. The specimen is in very good condition, with fine details visible on the leaf and minimal damage to the surrounding stone. The fossil shows excellent preservation of venation patterns and leaf structure. This piece is suitable for mineral and fossil collectors, educational study, or display purposes. Item is used and is subject to small imperfections not visible in pictures.
